name: Adult Gold Dragon
source: ActiveWorkspace shared catalog enriched by audited RandomEncounters data

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Multiattack
abilities.description: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

abilities.name: Tail
abilities.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

abilities.name: Frightful Presence
abilities.description: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

abilities.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
abilities.description:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Weakening Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

random_encounters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.description: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

homebrewAlignment.name: Lawful Guardian
homebrewAlignment.description: The steadfast protector of the realm. Uplifts the weak, obeys the law, and inspires trust with every step.
